field.defining_modulus: symmetric subalgebra of F2[z]/(z^107-1), modulo sum(z^i, i=0..106)
field.basis_coordinates: bit i-1 is coefficient of gamma_i=zeta^i+zeta^-i, i=1..n
field.element_encoding: nonnegative integer native ONB symmetric bit vector, normalized bit zero

factor_base.construction: signed-Frobenius closure of 2^k G for 0<=k<128 and one public Q orbit
factor_base.subgroup_filtering: G and Q verified in E[r]; doubling, sign and Frobenius preserve the subgroup
factor_base.sign_frobenius_quotient_rule: least cyclic x rotation; sign distinguished by full point replay

point_decomposition.summation_chain: complete unordered two-G pair-sum quotient index, queried by alpha G minus Q
point_decomposition.cache_policy: G-only pair index is built before the target online interval and reused across target blocks

relation_collection.query_distribution: independent OS-random alpha0 uniform Z_r and delta uniform nonzero Z_r for every affine block
relation_collection.rule: scan alpha_j=alpha0+j*delta, then restart independently after each complete miss
relation_collection.filtering: verify quotient hit by full point addition and independent scalar replay
relation_collection.duplicate_handling: retain first witness per signed-Frobenius pair-sum key
relation_collection.stop_criterion: first verified relation or 256 complete 4096-query blocks

relation_linear_algebra.rank_criterion: the target coefficient is one in the prime subgroup

target_descent.policy: direct recovery from a three-point relation containing public Q
target_descent.success_rule: recovered scalar independently reproduces public Q
target_descent.stop_rule: first verified relation or frozen block budget

algorithm_flags.random_law: independent OS-random alpha0 and nonzero delta per block

identity_hash_rule: first 12 lowercase SHA-256 hex of sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON identity_record
